verified_facts.text: The Meneghetti estate has 40,000 grape vines, 13 wine labels, 700 olive trees and 4 olive varieties.
verified_facts.excerpt: 40000 of grape vines 13 wine labels 700 olive trees 4 olive varieties

verified_facts.text: The Wine Lounge is set at the heart of the winery, surrounded by olive groves and vineyards, for tasting the estate's wines and olive oils.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set at the heart of the winery, the Wine Lounge invites you to slow down and savour the moment. Surrounded by olive groves and vineyards, it offers a beautiful setting for tasting our wines and olive oils.

verified_facts.text: The Meneghetti Beach Club is on the Adriatic.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Beach Club brings together the beauty of the Adriatic with the signature Meneghetti sense of ease.

verified_facts.text: Oliveto is an al fresco restaurant set among olive trees.
verified_facts.excerpt: Oliveto captures the ease of Mediterranean living, set among olive trees and open skies. An al fresco setting

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments are personalised face and body rituals using estate olive oil and grape extracts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Personalised face and body rituals using estate olive oil and grape extracts.

verified_facts.text: Spa rituals use cold-pressed olive oil from the estate, grape extracts from its vineyards and herbs such as lavender, sage and immortelle.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cold-pressed olive oil from the estate, antioxidant-rich grape extracts from our vineyards, and herbs such as lavender, sage and immortelle, gathered with care, form the foundation of each treatment

verified_facts.text: The Garden Spa has an outdoor Finnish sauna and cold plunge set within landscaped gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Outdoor Finnish sauna and cold plunge set within landscaped gardens.

verified_facts.text: The spa's indoor heated Family Pool welcomes families during dedicated hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indoor heated pool welcoming families during dedicated hours.

verified_facts.text: The Tranquillity Pool is a heated indoor pool reserved for quiet relaxation.
verified_facts.excerpt: Heated indoor pool reserved for quiet relaxation.

verified_facts.text: The Spa Lounge is a relaxation lounge with heated waterbeds and herbal infusions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relaxation lounge with heated waterbeds and herbal infusions.

verified_facts.text: The estate has a private tennis court framed by countryside and vineyards.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a private tennis court framed by rolling countryside and sunlit vineyards

verified_facts.text: The estate has a golf driving range.
verified_facts.excerpt: Refine your golf swing at the estate’s driving range, surrounded by tranquil, rolling landscapes.

verified_facts.text: Guests can do a sensory tasting of four estate olive oils.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience a sensory tasting of four estate olive oils

verified_facts.text: A privately chauffeured Bentley experience is offered for special occasions.
verified_facts.excerpt: A privately chauffeured Bentley experience, crafted to elevate special occasions

verified_facts.text: Guests can have a private dinner beneath centuries-old oaks overlooking the vineyards.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor a private dinner beneath centuries-old oaks, overlooking the sunlit vineyards of Meneghetti.

verified_facts.text: Guests can have a picnic among the estate's vineyards.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a leisurely picnic among our picturesque vineyards

verified_facts.text: A private truffle hunt in Istria's forests is followed by a tasting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Embark on a private truffle hunt in Istria’s forests, followed by a tasting

verified_facts.text: The harvest experience includes the grape harvest, the vineyards and wine cellar, and lunch beneath the oak canopy.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step into the world of the grape harvest, explore the vineyards and wine cellar, and enjoy lunch beneath the oak canopy.

verified_facts.text: A sunset sail on the Adriatic offers the chance to watch dolphins as Rovinj's old town is in view.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sail the Adriatic at sunset, watching dolphins play as Rovinj’s old town melts into the golden evening light.

verified_facts.text: Guests can explore Cape Kamenjak by kayak, swimming through a sea tunnel into a hidden cave.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover Cape Kamenjak by kayak, swimming through a sea tunnel into a hidden cave lit by natural turquoise light.
